body: Speech-to-speech dialogue models increasingly support persona control, yet existing spoken role-playing benchmarks remain largely character-centric and short-horizon. This leaves open whether spoken dialogue models can sustain diverse roles over extended interactions, especially beyond predefined fictional characters. We introduce RoleBreak, an open benchmark for long-horizon role-playing robustness in spoken dialogue. RoleBreak contains 310 character-based and user-centered roles, 6,688 human-verified dialogue turns, and 11,743 fine-grained evaluation criteria, with 1,856 turns carrying expressive emotion targets for evaluating vocal emotion. Its scenarios are designed to stress role consistency, interaction quality, safety, and affect over extended conversations. We evaluate nine configurations spanning full-duplex, omni-modal, and cascaded ASR--LLM--TTS paradigms. We find four key patterns. First, current systems are substantially stronger at semantic role adherence than at vocal emotion. Second, semantic robustness remains brittle over long interactions: even the strongest evaluated system encounters its first persona and safety failures after only 10.4 and 11.6 turns on average. Third, scaling the LLM substantially improves semantic robustness and delays failure, but yields little improvement in vocal emotion. Finally, user vocal emotion affects role-playing behavior even when linguistic content is fixed. These findings highlight persistent gaps in both long-horizon robustness and vocal expressiveness in spoken role-playing systems.
summaryZh: RoleBreak是一个针对长周期语音角色扮演鲁棒性的开源基准测试，包含310个角色、超6000个对话轮次及细粒度评估标准。研究评估了九种语音对话模型配置，发现当前系统在语义角色保持上表现尚可，但在长对话中极易出现人格与安全失效。此外，模型在语义鲁棒性与语音情感表达之间存在显著脱节，且用户的情感反馈会直接影响模型的角色扮演行为，为未来语音交互模型的设计提供了关键改进方向。

glossary.explanationZh: 指长周期、多轮次的交互过程，用于测试模型在长时间对话中的一致性。
全双工通信，指语音模型能够同时进行输入和输出，实现更自然的实时对话。
全模态，指模型能够直接处理多种模态（如音频、文本）的输入输出，无需中间转换。
级联架构，通过语音转文字、大模型处理、文字转语音三个独立模块串联实现语音交互。
语义鲁棒性，指模型在长对话中维持角色设定和逻辑一致性的能力。
